units.title: Opening a visit cost answer
units.text: When a member asks what a visit will cost, say you are looking at today's plan record and keep it short. Then read the Legal verbatim block word for word before giving any dollar amount.
units.source_span: Say you are looking at today's plan record. Keep it short. Then read the next block word for word, before any dollar amount.

units.title: Cost estimate disclaimer (Legal verbatim)
units.text: The cost I quote is an estimate for a covered in-network medical visit, based on the plan records I can see today. What you pay can change if the provider is out of network, if a referral is missing, or if your deductible status is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.
units.source_span: The cost I quote is an estimate for a covered in-network medical visit, based on the plan records I can see today. What you pay can change if the provider is out of network, if a referral is missing, or if your deductible status is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.

units.title: Handling 'is that all I pay?' follow-up
units.text: When members ask "so is that all I pay?", stop after the verbatim line. You may point at the copay or the deductible status on the record.
units.source_span: Members ask "so is that all I pay?" Stop after the verbatim line. You may point at the copay or the deductible status on the record.

units.title: Do not promise clinic billing amount
units.text: You may not promise the clinic will bill the quoted amount.
units.source_span: You may not promise the clinic will bill that amount.

units.title: HMO specialist visits require a referral
units.text: A specialist visit on a Harbor Medicare Advantage HMO needs a referral from the primary care doctor on file before the visit.
units.source_span: A specialist visit on a Harbor Medicare Advantage HMO needs a referral from the primary care doctor on file before the visit.

units.title: Check referral before quoting specialist cost
units.text: Check the account for the specialist referral, and quote a cost only when the referral is there.
units.source_span: Check the account for that referral, and quote a cost only when the referral is there.

units.title: Illustrative $35 specialist copay (training example)
units.text: The training example uses an in-network specialist copay of $35. That $35 figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: The training example uses an in-network specialist copay of $35. That $35 figure is illustrative.

units.title: No referral on file: offer request, no price
units.text: If the member has no referral on file, offer to send the request to the primary care office and do not invent a price.
units.source_span: If the member has no referral on file, offer to send the request to the primary care office and do not invent a price.

units.title: Referral required before quoting specialist copay (restatement)
units.text: The referral has to be on the account before you quote the specialist copay, and the illustrative training copay stays $35 only for that in-network example.
units.source_span: The referral has to be on the account before you quote the specialist copay, and the illustrative training copay stays $35 only for that in-network example.
